name: latch
description: A semantic commit layer for consequential actions on the web.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @latch/contracts && npm run build -w @latch/core && npm run build -w @latch/sdk && npm run build -w @latch/api && npm run build -w @latch/extension && npm run build -w @latch/dashboard
scripts.test: npm run test -w @latch/core && npm run test -w @latch/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @latch/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @latch/core && npm run typecheck -w @latch/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @latch/api && npm run typecheck -w @latch/extension && npm run typecheck -w @latch/dashboard
